testCase.name: [local] S20 Visual lane on the transcript panel: axe collapsed and open in both modes; phone width and WebKit with a 12-line row

descriptionHtml:
Bug A5 · P3 · accessibility

On phones a very long unbroken word in a transcript overflows the card and is cut off

Tickets: TFA-92594 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S20 Visual lane on the transcript panel: axe collapsed and open in both modes; phone width and WebKit with a 12-line row

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'. (TFA-92594 AC 1)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual-lane fixture seeded with the S05, S06 and S09 transcripts plus a line with a 120-character word; Desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles

When Run axe on both Encounter tabs, collapsed and with one row expanded; on the phone profiles, expand the 12-line row

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Each row button has an accessible name holding its label and line count, and aria-expanded follows the state. On phones: no horizontal page scroll, every line reachable through the inner scroll, no text covered or clipped, row tap targets at least 24 px / 44 pt

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-checks.ts: axe zero serious or critical; row name matches /lines/ and aria-expanded true only on the open row; overflow / covered / truncated / tap findings = 0 on the new screens; screenshots for a human. S21 (phone width and WebKit) merged here: same visual-lane pass and seeds

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

On a phone, a transcript line containing a very long unbroken word runs past the card edge and its end is cut off. The open row's scroll box also cannot be reached by keyboard, and some text fails contrast.

Evidence: Allure 1d7d481f, visual lane: 36 checks passed, 16 failed. On Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 the paragraph is 318 px wide but the text is 791 px, in the NH prior-visit row and the Hospital Recorded Transcript. The test uses a synthetic 120-character token, so this is a low-frequency edge case. axe also reports scrollable-region-focusable (serious) and contrast. Not in the dev report, ledger or matrix.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S20

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: yes): encounter.spec.ts: S05/S06/S09-shaped transcriptHistory + a 120-character word; collapsed and one row open, both modes; axe, row names (label + line count), aria-expanded, inner scroll to L12, phone covered/clipped/tap (44 on iPhone). [2026-10-14 review] Re-run with the stricter 'covered' rule (a fixed layer over a fixed layer is high).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 36 judged check(s) passed, 16 failed. Row buttons carry label + line count; aria-expanded follows the open row; L12 is reached by the inner scroll; tap sizes pass.

Product issue: A transcript line that contains a long unbroken token (the 120-character word) does not wrap: the paragraph is 318 px wide but its text 791 px, so the end of the line is cut off by the card edge on Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 — seen in the Nursing Home prior-visit row and the Hospital Recorded Transcript (oracle: no text covered or clipped). axe also flags the open row's scroll box as not keyboard-focusable (scrollable-region-focusable, serious) plus contrast.

Evidence: 8 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-16_S20 — a folder (27 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
